newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA BAT AFTER WINNING TOSS IN THIRD TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-AUSTRALIA BAT AFTER WINNING TOSS IN THIRD TEST.

text.p: Australia won the toss and decided to bat on the first day of the third test against England at Old Trafford on Thursday.
England gave a debut to the Kent paceman Dean Headley, who was preferred to Devon Malcolm and Mike Smith.
That made history as Headley's father Ron and grandfather George also played test cricket - albeit for the West Indies.
Australia had already announced that Jason Gillespie would return to their attack at the expense of Mike Kasprowicz.
The weather is overcast with showers forecast later in the day.
England - Michael Atherton (captain), Mark Butcher, Alec Stewart, Nasser Hussain, Graham Thorpe, John Crawley, Mark Ealham, Robert Croft, Darren Gough, Andy Caddick, Dean Headley.
Australia - Mark Taylor (captain), Matthew Elliott, Greg Blewett, Mark Waugh, Steve Waugh, Mark Bevan, Ian Healy, Shane Warne, Paul Reiffel, Jason Gillespie , Glenn McGrath.
